proposed.text: For columns and posts on exposed floors, decks, water-splash locations, or basements, what pedestal projection is source-supported unless resistant or treated wood is used?

options.text: At least 100 mm above exposed earth and 10 mm above finish floor.
At least 200 mm above exposed earth or at least 25 mm above finish floor level.

rationale.correct: Section 605.5 requires the pedestal to project at least 200 mm above exposed earth or at least 25 mm above finish floor level.
rationale.takeaway: Section 605.5 uses different pedestal projection thresholds for exposed earth and finished floors.
